summary: New APIRouter in service/api/version.py exposing GET /api/v1/version, returning VersionResponse{version}; registered in create_app before the redirect router.

components.name: VersionResponse
components.responsibility: Typed response model for the contract

adr.title: ADR-001: Version endpoint reads app.version
adr.context: Operators need to confirm the deployed build.
adr.decision: Read the version from the FastAPI app object instead of a constant.
adr.consequences: One place to bump on release; no extra config.

test_strategy: Integration test via the TestClient fixture; contract test covers the OpenAPI change.
